page.overview:
Who is Bobba and Jimma?

Bobba and Jimma are two blitzball commentators at Luca in Final Fantasy X. The player nor the party ever sees them; only their voices are heard. Their names seem to be derived from the more common Western names, Bob and Jim. In the Japanese version, they are not given names.
